summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited (NYSE: MMA), a foreign private issuer incorporated in Australia, furnished a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing completed actions that removed approximately US$1.71 million from its annualized cash operating cost base between January 1, 2025 and June 30, 2026. Reductions comprise US$1.54 million in workforce-related costs—US$345,000 Australian payroll, over US$1 million international payroll, and over US$196,000 taxes and benefits—plus US$165,000 from Hype functionality deprecation, insurance and hosting savings. The company frames the actions as embedded, not future targets, aiming to extend cash runway and strengthen the path to positive adjusted EBITDA. Watch execution risks around revenue capacity and remaining cash runway.
